changes.was: The wizard opened with a small generic heading.
changes.now: The Motion W, Gotham heading and restrained red accents connect Welcome to the app.

changes.was: Progress and action controls were visually small.
changes.now: Segmented progress names the current step; larger fields and Back/Continue controls create an obvious path forward.

changes.was: The existing flow owns validation, focus, saves and required steps.
changes.now: Those rules stay intact, including sheet choices, numeric entry, Back, and optional photo completion.

verification: Wisconsin build on iPhone 18 Pro Max / iOS 27.0: passed.
Native tests: 251 passed; source/API contracts: 821 passed; broader backend cases: 135 passed.
Simulator UI: 7 passed (full required student walkthrough, accessibility-size selections, and all five review regression paths).
TypeScript, touched-file ESLint (111 files), build:app, generated project membership, docs/codemaps, and audit inventory (82/82): passed.
Independent backend and native reviews: no actionable regressions.
Light and dark appearance inspected. Accessibility text retains a scrolling form and growing controls; decorative step artwork is omitted at accessibility sizes.
notes: Dark and large-text evidence are after-only: apparel-dark.png and apparel-large.png. Other final steps: wiscard-after.png, student-after.png and photo-after.png.
The current required-onboarding native source came from a preserved dirty-root snapshot. The visual refinement changes only the two Welcome view files; DEBUG fixtures are local proof inputs.
No server account was created. Authenticated invitation/onboarding rollout and physical photo-picker acceptance remain separate gates.
